subject: Quick priority check — implementation runway for HelixAI POC
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@helix.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@helix.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick priority check — implementation runway for HelixAI POC

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the POC kickoff: 

- What we covered: integration points (inference API + batch ingest), success metrics (99th p95 latency target for qps=30; embedding accuracy on threshold X), and compliance gating (audit logs + isolation).
- Action items for HelixAI: share a representative data sample and confirm the env where the test model will run (staging VPC or sandbox).
- Action items from Redwood: provide a one-page bootstrapping checklist, a basic mutual action plan, and offer a 90-minute pairing session with an engineer during setup.

I attached the draft mutual action plan and the checklist to get started. If HelixAI can complete the sample data and pick a preferred window for the pairing session by next Tuesday (9/28), we can target an internal ready-for-test cutoff the following week.

If priorities have shifted on your side, please let me know — happy to adjust the timeline.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0193

Attachments: HelixAI_MutualActionPlan_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), bootstrapping-checklist.md (text)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@helix.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick priority check — implementation runway for HelixAI POC

Hi Elena — following up on the checklist/mutual plan I sent last week. Haven't seen the sample data come through and wanted to check whether the POC is still on track for the timeline we discussed. 

If the team is tied up right now, two quick options:
1) We keep the current POC scope and shift the kickoff by 2–3 weeks.
2) We scope a smaller smoke test (ingest + single-model endpoint) that your platform team can stand up in one afternoon; Redwood will support live pairing.

Which would you prefer? If you want, I can book a 60-minute slot for pairing and loop in our solutions engineer to walk through the install steps.

Thanks — Sofia

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@helix.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@helix.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick priority check — implementation runway for HelixAI POC

Sofia — sorry for the radio silence. We had an internal reprioritization last week around our infrastructure refresh; the platform team is still tied to that.

We still want to evaluate Redwood — the technical owners asked for a smaller smoke test first so they can validate network policies and key rotation without committing the whole sandbox. Can you send a pared-down checklist and confirm how long the smoke test will take with Redwood pairing? Also, curious if there's any flexibility on the trial window.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering, HelixAI

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@helix.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick priority check — implementation runway for HelixAI POC

Thanks for the update, Elena — totally understand.

Short answers: the smoke test we recommend is ~2–3 hours of paired work (engineer-to-engineer) plus a short validation window (1 business day) to confirm metrics. I attached a condensed "smoke" checklist for the specific network/key rotation items your platform team called out.

On the trial window: yes, we can extend the trial by two weeks for customers that need more runway during infrastructure changes. If helpful, I can schedule the paired session as early as next Tuesday and loop in Marissa (solutions engineering) for hands-on setup.

Would next Tue 10/05 at 10am PT work for a 90-minute slot? If not, propose two alternatives and we'll take the earliest.

Best — Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@helix.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick priority check — implementation runway for HelixAI POC

Hi Elena — Marissa here from Solutions Engineering — looping in so we can jump straight into the hands-on pairing you requested. I can cover the network policy checks, quick key-rotation demo, and a minimal end-to-end smoke run. 

Proposed agenda for the 90-min session (I): 15 min access & networking validation; 30 min guided install + model ping; 20 min KV cache & latency profiling; 25 min validation + next-step checklist.

Prep asked of HelixAI: provide one example payload and the VPC CIDR you plan to use (or tell us you want to use our sandbox). We will provision a temporary test endpoint and leave it active for 48 hours after the session for your team to run additional checks.

If the 10/05 10am PT slot works, I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in + shared drive link (the draft mutual action plan and the condensed checklist are attached for quick reference). If you'd prefer a different time, tell us two options and we'll confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: HelixAI_MutualActionPlan_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), bootstrapping-checklist.md (text)
